headlines.description: — Paul George scored 29 points, Tyrese Maxey had eight of his 21 points in the final 30 seconds and the Philadelphia 76ers won back-to-back games for the first time this season with a 110-104 victory over the Charlotte Hornets on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Paul George, Tyrese Maxey lead 76ers over Hornets 110-104 to earn first first back-to-back wins

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 19 points and Evan Mobley had 19 points and 10 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the Wizards 118-87 on Tuesday night, extending Washington’s losing streak to 15.
headlines.shortLinkText: NBA-leading Cavaliers beat Wizards 118-87, extending Washington's losing streak to 15

headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 28 points and Damian Lillard had 27, lifting the surging Milwaukee Bucks to a 128-107 win over the Detroit...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucks advance in NBA Cup as Antetokounmpo and Lillard key 128-107 win over Pistons

headlines.description: — Karl-Anthony Towns had 23 points and 15 rebounds, Jalen Brunson scored 21 points and the New York Knicks beat the Orlando Magic 121-106 on Tuesday to reach the quarterfinals of the NBA Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks beat Magic to advance in the NBA Cup. Orlando also moves on as the East wild card

events.name: Orlando Magic at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Scottie Barnes scored a career-high 35 points, RJ Barrett added 29 and the Toronto Raptors never trailed in a 122-111 win over the Pacers on Tuesday night that extended Indiana’s road losing streak to seven.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scottie Barnes scores career-high 35 as Raptors win 122-111, extend Pacers' road skid to 7

headlines.description: — Jalen Williams scored 28 points, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 26 points, seven assists and six rebounds, and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Utah Jazz 133-106 on Tuesday night en route to the NBA Cup quarterfinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thunder beat Jazz 133-106 and advance to the NBA Cup quarterfinals

events.name: Utah Jazz at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 37 points and 12 rebounds, Spencer Dinwiddie and P.J. Washington Jr. hit clutch 3-pointers in the final two minutes, and the Dallas Mavericks overcame a 15-point deficit to beat the Memphis Grizzlies 121-116 on Tuesday night and...
headlines.shortLinkText: Mavericks rally late to beat Grizzlies 121-116 and advance to NBA Cup quarterfinals

headlines.description: — Devin Booker scored 29 points and the Phoenix Suns weathered the loss of Kevin Durant to an ankle injury to beat the San Antonio Spurs 104-93 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Booker scores 29 and Suns lose Durant to ankle injury in 104-93 win over Spurs

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 38 points, 10 rebounds and five steals to rally the Denver Nuggets to a 119-115 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic scores 38 points and helps Nuggets mount a late comeback to beat Warriors 119-115

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — Domantas Sabonis scored 27 points and Sacramento made 15 straight shots from the field to beat Houston 120-111 on Tuesday night and deny the Rockets the top seed in the NBA Cup quarterfinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Kings make 15 straight shots to beat the Rockets 120-111

headlines.description: — Norman Powell scored 30 points, James Harden had 23 and the Los Angeles Clippers beat the Portland Trail Blazers 127-105 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Powell scores 30 and Harden has 23 as the Clippers beat the Trail Blazers 127-105

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at LA Clippers
